vocabulary_ceiling_announcement: The vocabulary ceiling was raised from 4096 to 8192 and the change was announced on the audit surface. See seed/tasks/OER-16/drift.yaml mutation announce-vocabulary-ceiling-raised.
note: Fixed compute is a fixed number of optimizer updates, where one update is one token consumed from the frozen training stream. A coarser vocabulary covers more bytes per update; that trade is the whole of the free axis.
